phase_name: Correct Python floor, directory casing, and Nix prose in ENVIRONMENT_SETUP.md

objectives.description: Fix Python floor (3.8 -> 3.10) and four ModelChecker/Code casing occurrences
Migrate six shell.nix/nix-shell references to flake.nix/nix develop, restructuring cwd flow so flake.nix/.envrc checks run at repo root and a cd code step bridges to code/-relative commands

deviations.description: Rewrite the Development Shell subsection's three bullets describing what shell.nix automatically did
deviations.reason: Verified against flake.nix: PYTHONPATH-setting and dependency-provisioning are both true (shellHook sets PYTHONPATH; devPython packages include z3-solver/networkx/pytest). The third claimed bullet, 'Makes development scripts executable', has no corresponding chmod/executable-bit step anywhere in flake.nix, so it was dropped rather than restated, per the plan's instruction to verify each bullet and drop any the flake does not actually do.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — dropped the unverifiable 'makes scripts executable' bullet; flake.nix has no such step)*

deviations.description: Fix line 103 (ls shell.nix .envrc) and adjust the surrounding cd as needed
deviations.reason: flake.nix and .envrc live at the repository root, not under code/. Changed the NixOS Repository Setup subsection's cd target from code/ to the repo root (ModelChecker) so the ls check resolves, and added a 'cd code' step in the Development Shell subsection so the Verification subsection's ./run_tests.py and ./dev_cli.py invocations (which live under code/) remain correct. Also adjusted the Automatic Environment Activation subsection's re-entry cd to the repo root, since .envrc (direnv) is anchored there.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — restructured cwd flow across NixOS Setup subsections 1-3 to match flake.nix/.envrc's actual repo-root location, not just a string substitution)*
